_comment: Private events page. The narrative sections (evening, runOfShow, sampleMenu, drinks, space, pros, swag) are generalised from a real client proposal — they describe the shape of an evening, not a fixed offer. Prices live only in `packages`; everything else is quoted, so nothing here can contradict the estimator.
intro: Corporate outings, birthday blowouts, team building and everything in between — court time, food and drink handled in one place.

packages.name: Food Packages
packages.lead: Three tiers, priced per person by how long you have the room:

items.name: Classic Social
items.desc: Welcome bites, display station, featured station, sweet finish

items.name: Signature Smash
items.desc: Passed amuse, reception display, interactive station, dessert

items.name: Luxe Celebration
items.desc: Elevated cocktail hour, two feature stations, dessert finale

packages.note: All menus include court time, unlimited fountain sodas, coffee, tea and water. Per person, plus tax and service.

packages.name: Beverage Packages
packages.note: Drink tickets or a consumption bar are also available. Packages vary by event.

upgrades.lead: Add a pickleball pro, swag, a champagne toast, a photo booth and more.

A room of guests raising a toast in front of the ELEVENO wall

venue.heading: More than just
venue.body: ELEVENO is the go-to destination for events that bring people together. From company outings, birthday parties, team-building sessions and social gatherings, our venue combines competition, dining and entertainment in one place. With premier courts, signature food and beverage, and flexible event spaces, every detail is designed to make your event seamless and unforgettable.

enhancements.lead: Customize your event — inquire for pricing.

groups.name: Enhancements
groups.note: Bar rental options are subject to availability.

form._comment: eventTypes mirror the categories already listed on the home page. referrals are a starting set — confirm before launch.

evening.heading: Play first,
evening.lead: Every event we run splits in two. Guests arrive to a bar and a court, and finish around a table. Nobody stands in a corner holding a drink wondering what happens next.

acts.label: Act one
acts.name: Courts & cocktails
acts.body: The bar opens as guests arrive. Pros run games and drills across your courts while anyone taking a break heads for the yard games. Paddles and instruction are included — nobody sits out.

acts.label: Act two
acts.name: The private back room
acts.body: The group moves through to a reserved room for a full sit-down or buffet service, with its own bartender. Mains, sides, and a dessert station, finished with a toast.

runOfShow.heading: What an evening looks like
runOfShow.lead: A three-hour evening for a corporate group, as an example. Yours gets built around your headcount and your start time.

rows.name: Arrival & welcome
rows.body: Bar opens, welcome amenity, guests get their paddles.

rows.name: Pickleball with the pros
rows.body: Drills, games and a mini-tournament across your courts. Yard games running alongside.

rows.name: Dinner service
rows.body: Full buffet or plated service in the private room — mains, sides and salads.

rows.name: Dessert & toast
rows.body: Dessert station, a toast, and awards for whoever won the tournament.

sampleMenu.heading: What we put on the table
sampleMenu.lead: One recent winter evening, to show the range. Every menu is built with you — final selections are due fourteen days before the event.
sampleMenu.note: Dietary-specific and themed menus are no trouble — tell us what you need and the kitchen will build around it.

drinks.heading: Open bar,
drinks.body: Imported and domestic beers, sparkling, white and red wine, spirits, mocktails and soft drinks. Bartenders on the floor through the event, plus a private bartender in the back room when you have it.
drinks.note: Bundled into the per-guest rate rather than billed separately, so the number you agree is the number you pay.

space.heading: Courts, and a room of your own

items.name: Exclusive courts
items.body: Private court time for the length of your event, with pros running games and a mini-tournament if you want one.

items.name: Yard games
items.body: Cornhole and lawn games for anyone taking a break from the paddle.

items.name: Private back room
items.body: A reserved room for dinner, with its own bartender and space to decorate however you like.

pros.heading: Put a pro on your court
pros.body: Certified pros run drills, games and a mini-tournament across your courts. They keep everyone moving and everyone playing, whatever the mix of experience in the room — most groups have never held a paddle and that is exactly the point.
pros.note: Paddle rental included for every guest. Coaching is charged per pro per hour and quoted with your estimate.

swag.heading: Everyone takes the court in style
swag.lead: Send your group home with something. We produce it in your branding, not ours.

items.name: Branded paddle
items.body: Your mark on the face, in your brand colours.

items.name: Branded shirt
items.body: Your logo on the front, ELEVENO on the chest, your tagline on the back.

items.name: Branded bag
items.body: Carries the paddle and the shirt — branded too.

swag.note: Priced per guest. Shirt sizes are collected with the RSVP, and mockups come to you for approval before anything goes to production.

hero.heading: Throw the party
hero.lead: Groups of 8 to full buyouts of 200+. Courts, kitchen, four bars and a beer garden — one venue, one contact, zero stress. Parking's on us.

pillars.name: World-Class Pickleball
pillars.body: Fifteen championship courts, indoor and outdoor.

pillars.name: Exceptional Food & Drinks
pillars.body: A full kitchen and four full-service bars.

steps.heading: Plan it in
steps.lead: Corporate event, birthday blowout or private party — we handle every detail so you can focus on your guests. And on winning, obviously.
steps.ctaHeading: Groups of 8 to 200+ — let's build yours.

foodSection.heading: Nobody plays
foodSection.lead: All menus include court time and unlimited fountain sodas, coffee, tea & water stations. Per person, 2- or 3-hour options.

tiers.name: Classic Social
tiers.body: Loaded baskets, flatbreads, wings & shareable favorites for every guest.

tiers.name: Signature Smash
tiers.body: Chef-crafted stations, charcuterie boards & elevated hot plates.

tiers.name: Luxe Celebration
tiers.body: Premium chef stations, carving & dessert for an unforgettable night.
